dataset_spec.name: physionet_2012
dataset_spec.description: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2012 ICU set A (first 1000 patients). Binary in-hospital death from 48-hour named vitals and laboratories.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult intensive-care stay. The prediction uses demographics, ICU type, and the last and mean of named vitals and laboratories recorded during the first 48 hours, before in-hospital death is known.

icu_death.question: Based on the first 48-hour ICU vitals and laboratories, will the patient die in hospital?
